newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - Wesfarmers looking overseas - MD.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - Wesfarmers looking overseas - MD.

text.p: Diversified Australian rural services group Wesfarmers Ltd is looking at opportunities for expansion overseas, managing director Michael Chaney said on Wednesday.
In response to a shareholder query about the future direction of growth, Chaney told the annual meeting that a senior manager was "developing relations" with a number of countries.
However, he stressed that the main focus of the energy, rural services, forestry and timber products, and chemical manufacturing conglomerate, will remain on Australia.
The managing director of Wesfarmers Bunnings Ltd Warren Murphy said the company had built up a stable of seven warehouses over the last two years, including five in Victoria.
Another four would be operating by December and about 40 by the year 2000 by which time he expected sales in excess of A$1 billion a year, Murphy said.
Responding to another shareholder query, Chaney said Wesfarmers would be an interested party should the Western Australian state government privatise the Dampier to Perth gas pipeline.
"The South Australian gas pipeline was privatised last year and it is not generally known that we were a bidder for it," Chaney said.
"The same goes for the Dampier to Perth gas pipeline. We are likely to be evaluating it with other parties or by ourselves," he said.
